mechanisms.summary: Positive central law supplied as an exact decimal spectrum, with tilted COS tail enclosure.
boundaries: Independent standard normals; strictly positive exact supplied decimal coefficients; integrated omitted-mode bound requires rank > 2.
Automatic design requires threshold strictly above exact decimal spectral mean; explicit evaluator accepts nonnegative threshold with valid parameters.
Strings/Decimal express exact decimal intent; float input means its str decimal, not its exact binary fraction.

mechanisms.summary: Central signed Gaussian reduction, mixed-sign and finite-endpoint tail engines.

boundaries: mpmath==1.3.0 interval arithmetic/transcendentals and Python/Decimal endpoint operations remain the software trust base.
0 < theta < eta < 1/(2*lambda_max), upper > threshold >= 0, K >= 1, rank > 2.
A positive lower tilted-sum endpoint is required to take the log; passed_positive_sum does not prove a requested multiplicative tolerance.

mechanisms.summary: Accuracy-driven K/support/precision refinement and directed multiplicative acceptance.
boundaries: Acceptance uses outward literal log10 endpoints; float summaries are display-only.

Public whole-operation lock restores point and interval precision; arbitrary external concurrent mpmath context mutation is outside contract.
